sale_terms_subtitle: Transparent rules for ordering, delivery, payments and using the Canzi platform.
sale_section1_desc: Customers can choose restaurants and products through the Canzi application, add them to their cart, and confirm the order after selecting the delivery address and payment method. Once the order is confirmed, the restaurant starts preparing the order and the delivery driver handles the delivery.
sale_section2_desc: Canzi offers Cash on Delivery (COD). Electronic payment methods may also be available depending on the city and service availability.
sale_section3_desc: Canzi aims to deliver orders as quickly as possible depending on restaurant location, weather conditions, and order volume. Delivery times remain estimated and may vary.
sale_section4_desc: Customers may cancel orders before preparation begins. Once the restaurant confirms preparation, cancellation may no longer be possible. In case of issues, customers can contact Canzi support.
sale_section5_desc: Canzi acts as an intermediary between customers, restaurants, and delivery drivers. The company is not responsible for delays caused by circumstances beyond its control.
sale_section6_desc: Canzi respects user privacy and uses personal data only for processing orders and improving services.
sale_section7_desc: By using the Canzi application, users agree to comply with all applicable laws and avoid fraudulent or abusive use of the platform.
sale_footer_note: By using the Canzi application, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.

privacy_subtitle: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information on Canzi.
privacy_intro_text:
Done is committed to protecting the privacy of its users, partners, and delivery drivers. This policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal data when using our services via the application or website.

We understand the importance of privacy and data protection in the digital age, and we are committed to the highest standards to ensure the safety of your personal information. This document is the main reference for understanding your rights and our obligations toward you as users of our platform.

By accessing this document, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the terms of this Privacy Policy, and you agree to our practices regarding data collection and processing as described on this page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically for any updates that may occur.
privacy_scope_text:
This policy applies to all users of the Done application, including customers, partners (service providers), and delivery workers. This policy governs the practices of data collection, processing, and sharing within the Done platform.

This policy does not apply to external websites or services linked to the application. This policy has been prepared in accordance with the provisions of Law No. 08-09 relating to the protection of individuals with regard to the automated processing of personal data, as adopted by Royal Decree No. 1-09-15.

This scope applies to all devices whether smartphones, tablets, or desktop computers, and in all geographic regions where the platform operates. In the event of a conflict between this policy and any other agreement, the provisions of this policy shall prevail unless expressly stated otherwise.
privacy_collect_text:
We collect multiple types of data in order to provide our services in an efficient and secure manner. This data includes information you provide directly when registering or using the services, as well as data collected automatically during your interaction with the platform.

3.1 Identity Data:
Full name
Email address
Phone number
Date of birth
Nationality

3.2 Geographic Location Data:
Real-time location during app usage
Delivery or pickup address
Saved locations history

3.3 Usage Data:
Order and transaction history
Time and date of each operation
Device type and operating system
IP address and browser used
privacy_legal_basis_text:
The processing of your personal data is based on clear and legitimate legal grounds in accordance with applicable legislation. We do not carry out any data processing without an explicit legal justification permitting it.

The main legal bases we rely on include: the user's explicit consent, contractual necessity for performing the requested services, compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, and legitimate interest in developing and improving our services.

You have the right at any time to withdraw your consent to the processing of your data, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to the withdrawal. To withdraw consent, you may contact us through the designated channels mentioned at the end of this document.
privacy_purpose_text:
We use the data we collect for specific and necessary purposes to operate the platform and improve the user experience. We do not use your data for purposes beyond what is declared in this policy without obtaining your prior consent.

5.1 Primary Purposes:
Providing delivery services and requested transactions
Creating and managing user accounts
Processing payments and billing
Communicating with users regarding their orders

5.2 Secondary Purposes:
Improving service quality and developing new features
Conducting statistical analyses and performance reports
Detecting fraud and preventing misuse
Complying with legal and regulatory requirements
privacy_sharing_text:
We do not sell your personal data to third parties in any form. We may share some of your data with trusted partners under strict controls that ensure its protection and use only for specified purposes.

Legitimate sharing cases include: electronic payment service providers, delivery partners, cloud infrastructure providers, and regulatory and supervisory authorities when legally required. In all these cases, we adhere to strict contracts that restrict data use and protect your privacy.

In the event of a merger, acquisition, or restructuring, your data may be transferred to the new entity, and you will be notified in advance with the option to delete your data if you wish.
privacy_retention_text:
We retain your personal data for the duration of your account activity with us, and for the period necessary after account closure to fulfill legal and regulatory obligations.

Retention periods vary by data type: transaction data is retained for 5 years in accordance with accounting requirements, identity data is retained for 3 years after the end of the contractual relationship, and usage data is retained for a period not exceeding one year.

After the retention periods expire, data is deleted or subjected to anonymization procedures in a secure and complete manner. You may at any time request the deletion of your data in accordance with the procedures outlined in the user rights section.
privacy_security_text:
We implement advanced technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, or deletion. These measures include full encryption of data during transmission and storage using SSL/TLS protocols and AES-256 standards.

We adopt a limited access policy whereby no employee may access data except within the scope required by their job. We also conduct periodic security audits and penetration tests to detect any potential vulnerabilities and address them before they pose a risk.

Despite the seriousness of the measures taken, absolute security cannot be guaranteed for any electronic system. We therefore recommend that you take your own precautions, such as using strong passwords and not sharing your login credentials with any third party.
privacy_breach_text:
In the event of the discovery of any security breach affecting your personal data, we are committed to notifying the competent regulatory authorities within the legally specified deadline, which does not exceed 72 hours from the moment of discovery.

We are also committed to notifying you directly if the breach poses a high likelihood of risk to your rights and freedoms. The notification will include a description of the nature of the breach, the types of data affected, the measures taken to mitigate its effects, and steps you can take to protect yourself.

We have an incident response plan that is activated as soon as any breach is discovered, including isolating the affected systems, analyzing the scope of the breach, restoring data from backups, and strengthening security measures to prevent recurrence.
privacy_cookies_text:
We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience on our platform, remember your preferences, and analyze usage patterns. Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website.

11.1 Types of cookies used:
Essential: necessary for the website to function properly and cannot be disabled
Functional: save your preferences such as language and time zone
Analytical: help us understand how you use the website
Marketing: used to display advertisements relevant to your interests

You can control cookies through your browser settings or via the cookie preferences panel available on our website. Disabling certain types of cookies may affect the performance of certain functions on the platform.
privacy_updates_text:
We reserve the right to amend this policy at any time to keep pace with changes in our practices, legal requirements, or technical developments. The date of the last update will be indicated at the top of the page.

In the event of material changes to this policy, we will notify you via your registered email address or through a prominent notice within the application at least 30 days before the amendments come into effect.

Your continued use of our services after the amendments take effect constitutes implicit acceptance of the updated policy. If you do not agree to the amendments, you have the right to terminate your account, stop using our services, and request the deletion of your data.
privacy_contact_text:
If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or our data processing practices, we are happy to hear from you through the following channels:

13.1 Contact Channels:
Email: privacy@done-app.ma
Phone: 0522-000-000
Address: Mohammed V Avenue, Casablanca, Kingdom of Morocco
Contact form available within the application

We are committed to responding to all privacy-related inquiries within no more than 15 working days from the date of receipt. For requests to exercise rights (access, correction, deletion), the period may extend to 30 days in accordance with applicable legislation.
privacy_footer_note: By using our platform, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
